sources.title: LingBot-World | Open Source AI World Model - Free Deploy
sources.snippet: LingBot-World AI World Model LingBot-World is the first open-source real-time interactive world model that rivals Google Genie 3 in quality. Experience zero-code world generation from a single image. This revolutionary AI world simulator lets you explore infinite procedurally generated worlds in real-time with stable long-term memory - no pre-rendered assets, no coding required.

sources.title: AI StackLab on X: "Embodied AI needs more than beautiful videos. It ...
sources.snippet: Embodied AI needs more than beautiful videos. It needs models that understand actions and consequences. LingBot-Video stood out to me immediately. Physical grounding. Efficient inference. Developer-first. Really impressed by the team's focus on solving practical robotics challenges instead of chasing visual quality alone.
